question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**productivity**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage describes the benefits of effective time management.
 
• The word to fill the blank should describe what individuals can improve by prioritizing tasks.
 
• "Productivity" refers to the effectiveness of productive effort, especially in industry, measured in terms of the rate of output per unit of input. It directly relates to improving output through better time management.
 
• The other options do not fit as well in describing the direct result of prioritizing tasks.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

Complete Passage: *Effective time management is (1) crucial__ for success. By prioritising tasks, individuals can enhance (2)__**productivity **__and reduce stress. Planning allows for a balance (3)_____work and personal life. Studies show that those who manage their time (4) _____are more likely to achieve their goals. It is a skill (5)____positively impacts both professional and personal aspects of life.**.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Capacity** (क्षमता): "Capacity" refers to the ability to hold, receive, or accommodate, which is not directly enhanced by prioritizing tasks.
 
• **Fertility** (उत्पादकता): "Fertility" refers to the ability to reproduce, which is irrelevant to time management.
 
• **Production** (उत्पादन): While related, "production" is a broader term, and "productivity" is more precise in the context of individual output and time management.
